{"command":"# Cleaning up and fixing helpKey.
cat <<'EOF' > main.go
package main

import (
	"flag"
	"fmt"
	"os"
	"oviewer/oviewer"
)

func main() {
	var (
		align          = flag.Bool("align", false, "")
		alternateRows  = flag.Bool("alternate-rows", false, "")
		lineNum        = flag.Bool("line-number", false, "")
		header         = flag.Int("header", 0, "")
		version        = flag.Bool("version", false, "")
		help           = flag.Bool("help", false, "")
		helpKey        = flag.Bool("help-key", false, "")
		columnMode     = flag.Bool("column-mode", false, "")
		wrap           = flag.Bool("wrap", true, "")
	)
	
	flag.BoolVar(align, "l", false, "")
	flag.BoolVar(alternateRows, "C", false, "")
	flag.BoolVar(lineNum, "n", false, "")
	flag.IntVar(header, "H", 0, "")
	flag.BoolVar(help, "h", false, "")
	flag.BoolVar(columnMode, "c", false, "")
	flag.BoolVar(wrap, "w", true, "")

	flag.Usage = func() {
		fmt.Print(helpText)
	}

	flag.Parse()

	if *version {
		fmt.Println("ov version dev rev:HEAD")
		return
	}

	if *help {
		flag.Usage()
		return
	}

	if *helpKey {
		fmt.Print(helpKeyText)
		return
	}

	args := flag.Args()
	if len(args) == 0 {
		return
	}

	doc, err := oviewer.OpenDocument(args[0])
	if err != nil {
		fmt.Printf("Error: %v\n", err)
		os.Exit(1)
	}

	root := oviewer.NewRoot(doc)
	root.Header = *header
	root.LineNumMode = *lineNum
	root.ColumnMode = *columnMode
	root.WrapMode = *wrap
	
	if err := root.Run(); err != nil {
		fmt.Printf("Error: %v\n", err)
		os.Exit(1)
	}
